explanation: Pope Leo III crowned him in St Peter's in Rome. His biographer Einhard says he kept writing tablets under his pillow, trying to learn to write late in life.

claims.text: Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne, king of the Franks, as emperor on Christmas Day in 800.

The coronation took place in St Peter's Basilica in Rome.
Einhard wrote that Charlemagne kept writing tablets under his pillow because he tried to learn to write late in life.
